description:
Read Roslyn compiler/analyzer diagnostics for Unity-managed C# under Assets/ or Packages/. This validates source without applying changes or reloading Unity.

File scope is fast and also checks tags, layers, build-scene references, Resources paths, and legacy Input axes against project configuration. Workspace scope catches cross-file compiler/analyzer errors but omits these string-reference checks; its first query can take minutes. Enabled Unity analyzers add UNT* diagnostics. Use the narrowest scope that covers the affected behavior.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to a Unity-managed .cs file under Assets/ or Packages/. Omit to query the whole workspace.

scope.description: 'file' or 'workspace'. Default: 'file' when file_path is given, otherwise 'workspace'.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity to report, that severity and above ('warning' = errors + warnings): 'error', 'warning' (default), 'info' or 'hint'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of diagnostics to return. Default 100, max 400.
